timing_scope: Amortized per trial: actual grouped audit sampling, common m19 draws, primary interval/full512 envelope, helper CPU and JSON transport. Uniform fixture performs SRS20 of L; mixed costfixture fixes the explicit valid selected20 (helper SRS20 of20). Preparation timed separately once per cell; conditional descriptive multipliers excluded. Executor elapsed includes process startup.
